title: dortmanna pulchella
intro: Dortmanna pulchella, commonly known as the 'Dortmann's beauty' or 'Dortmanna pulchella', is a flowering plant species in the family Gentianaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being.
